provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: Toy Battle rules (Repos Production, via RulesPal)

steps.text: Choose 1 of the 8 Terrains (first game: Castle Field) and lay it between you
steps.note: The symbol in front of you sets your colour and the Medals objective

steps.text: A Medal marker on every Medal space; box the rest
Take a rack; shuffle your colour's Troops facedown as your reserve
Return 4 Troops from your reserve to the box unseen
Start player draws 3 Troops onto their rack; the other player draws 4
Leave space beside the board for discards; player aid in reach
First games: treat special bases as plain bases (no effect)
Your rack holds at most 8 Troops
Every Troop must be placed on a slot connected to your H.Q. through bases you occupy
You may cover only your own Troops or enemy Troops of strictly lower strength
Random start player; each turn draw 2 Troops or place 1
